summary: V8 Field Synthesis Engine integration tested end-to-end against the live backend. 6 of 7 pytest tests pass (86%). PASSING: GET /api/health surfaces astrology_field_synthesis_v8=true and field_synthesis_marker='astrology-field-synthesis-v8' AND ask_mirror_astrology_v7=true AND mirror_chat_router_version='ask-mirror-astrology-v7'. Unit-level build_field_synthesis() on Mel's chart returns success=True, is_empty=True, house_sign='Virgo', ruler='Mercury', ruler_sign='Gemini', ruler_house=11, destabilizing_planet='Saturn' (Mercury-Saturn hard aspect detected), synthesis_mode='field', textbook_mode_used=False, narrative > 200 chars. Live /api/mirror/chat: Pete asking 'Tell me about Mel's 4th house' (lens=null) routes through V7 (target_resolved=Mel, MEL_ID) and V8 (field_synthesis injected with all expected determinist fields). Pete's 10th and 1st house lens='astrology' calls fire V8 with correct house_number. Regressions confirmed: 'my whole chart' and 'natal Chiron' branches do NOT inject field_synthesis. FAILING: response prose for Mel's 4th house contains 'mercury'/'virgo'/'gemini' but NOT 'saturn' — destabilizing planet is named in debug.field_synthesis.destabilizing_planet='Saturn' but never surfaces in the response text. Investigation shows the LLM is returning the deterministic synthesis_narrative seed verbatim, and that seed only uses Saturn's destabilizer *phrase* ('the field is editing itself, narrower than the interior wants') without naming Saturn. The proof block names Saturn in the destabilizing_planet line but the LLM does not weave it into prose.

minor.issue: Response prose does not surface destabilizing_planet name. For Pete-asks-about-Mel's-4th-house, debug.field_synthesis.destabilizing_planet='Saturn' but the response text contains only Saturn's destabilizer phrase ('the field is editing itself'), never the word 'Saturn'. Spec requires response prose to mention Mercury AND Virgo AND Gemini AND Saturn. Root cause: field_synthesis_engine.py:556-559 builds 'What disrupts it: {destabilizer_text}' from _DESTABILIZER_BY_PLANET which is phrase-only — the planet name itself is dropped. Fix: change the seed to include the planet name, e.g. 'What disrupts it: Saturn — the field is editing itself…'. The LLM is returning the seed verbatim so the planet name must be baked into the deterministic narrative.

What disrupts it: {destab_planet} — {destabilizer_text}.'). After fix, re-run test_pete_asks_mel_4th_field_synthesis to confirm 'saturn' token appears in prose.

Optional: ensure the LLM ELABORATES the seed (not just echoes) — current behaviour for the Mel 4th-house call is that the response IS exactly the synthesis_narrative seed. This is acceptable per V8 design (deterministic prose) but means any required tokens must be embedded in the seed.
critical_code_review_comments: field_synthesis_engine.py is well-structured but the 'destabilizer' text intentionally drops the planet name in favour of an experiential phrase. This collides with the testability requirement that the response mention the planet by name. Embedding the planet name in the seed is the cleanest fix.

The deterministic engine correctly detects destabilizing_planet='Saturn' (Mercury-Saturn aspect within orb) and exposes it in debug.field_synthesis.destabilizing_planet, but the synthesis_narrative seed only includes Saturn's experiential destabilizer phrase ('the field is editing itself, narrower than the interior wants') without the word 'Saturn'.
